history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Import Depot Activity ECOR Number Regenerate details.
features: ECOR Number Regenerate function is used to regenerate ECOR Number.
If the ECOR number of a container has a certain value, then after regeneration, the ECOR number will remain the same.

events.description: Opens the ECOR Number Regenerate screen in a new tab
events.triggered_when: User clicks the ☰ icon at Voyage level in Depot Activity and selects "ECOR Number Regenerate"

events.description: Queries the records matching the query parameters and lists them in the grid, with the count in Total Record(s)
events.triggered_when: User selects the Discharge Voyage and clicks Search

events.description: Clears the query fields and the grid
Selects or deselects all records in the grid
events.triggered_when: User clicks the select-all check box in the grid header

events.description: Selects or deselects the individual record
events.triggered_when: User clicks the check box of a record

events.description: Validates whether ECOR Numbers can be regenerated for the selected records
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more records and clicks Check List
events.remarks: "No Errors Found - ECOR Number can be Re-Generated"

events.description: Regenerates ECOR Numbers for the selected records; an existing ECOR Number remains the same
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more records and clicks Regenerate
